---
title: "simstim host set"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Change a host's settings, such as idle or tier.

```text
simstim host set <host> <key>=<value>... [flags]
```

Change named settings of a host, and only those. It checks every pair before it changes anything, then applies them in the order given.

idle: how long a host that `host create` made may idle before it stops. It takes a time of a minute or more, such as 30m or 2h, or never.

tier: who else has root on the host: own, throwaway or shared. Lowering works at once. Raising connects to check the pinned host key, and asks for the host's typed name.

label.: a note, such as label.location=home. An empty value removes that label. Labels never select a host or allow a grant.

drain: refuse new sandboxes while running sessions continue. Give a short reason, or off to clear it.

## Examples

```sh
simstim host set lima idle=2h
simstim host set lima idle=never
simstim host set my-vps tier=shared
simstim host set my-vps tier=own --confirm my-vps
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--confirm <host>` | the name of the host, typed here instead of at the question when raising its tier |

## Flags from the parent command

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--debug[=<categories>]` | turn on the debug mode, with every category, or with the categories listed: attach, net, memory, launcher, runtime. A list binds only in the = form, such as `--debug=net` |
| `--debug-file <file>` | write the client's debug records to this file. On its own, it turns on every category (SIMSTIM_DEBUG_FILE does the same) |
| `--no-color` | print no colour (NO_COLOR does the same) |
| `--no-input` | ask nothing: a question that needs an answer fails with exit code 4, and names the flag that answers it (SIMSTIM_NO_INPUT=1 does the same) |

## Old names

These still work, and print a warning on stderr, until their end.

| Old | New | Works until | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| host idle &lt;host&gt; &lt;time&gt; | host set &lt;host&gt; idle=&lt;time&gt; | v0.4.0 and 11 November 2027, whichever comes later |  |
